messages.author: 74c1fc446febd7ee
messages.subject: shared variance
parts:
Hi, could anyone help me on how to obtain the matrix of share variance among constructs in lavaan?
Thank you.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: shared variance
parts:
You mean the covariance (or correlation) matrix among latent constructs?  If you are running a CFA, then that is simply the PSI matrix:

inspect(output, "coef")$psi
cov2cor(inspect(output, "coef")$psi)

If you have structural regressions (in the BETA matrix), then PSI is the residual covariance matrix.  In that case, the total covariance matrix is a function of BETA and PSI, but you can get it this way:

inspect(output, "cor.lv")

There's a list of information you can get with inspect() under the Methods section of the lavaan-class help page:

?lavaan::inspect

Terry
